title: VAST: The Valence-Assessing Semantics Test for Contextualizing Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) effect sizes based on the cosine similarity of contextualized word embeddings (after nullifying top principal components) between European American vs. African American names and pleasant vs. unpleasant words.

Calculating WEAT effect sizes using contextualized word embeddings (after semantic isolation) to measure differential associations between male/female names or words and concepts like career/family, math/art, and science/art.
Calculating WEAT effect sizes using contextualized word embeddings (after semantic isolation) to measure differential associations between young vs. old names and pleasant vs. unpleasant words.

Calculating WEAT effect sizes using contextualized word embeddings (after semantic isolation) to measure differential associations between physical vs. mental diseases and permanent vs. temporary concepts.
